suppress.notes:
Reviewed 2026-08-08. CVE-2026-66299 affects the Apache Tomcat WebSocket chat example application. WoSB uses embedded Tomcat and does not package or deploy the Tomcat examples web application. Apache states installations without the examples web application are not affected.
Removal condition: - remove this suppression as soon as embedded Tomcat is >= 11.0.25, or - remove/review it immediately if Apache changes the affected scope.
CI runs Dependency-Check daily with failBuildOnUnusedSuppressionRule=true. Therefore an upgrade that makes this rule unused intentionally fails the security job until this entry is deleted. The explicit expiry is a second fail-closed review deadline.
